[element-hr]
=== `<hr>` Horizontal Rule

Defined to allow the standards producer to specify an explicit (non machine-generated) rule.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice

Many uses of this element can be replaced with a <<attribute-style,`@style`>> attribute on the containing structure.

#### Attributes

#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-td,`<td>`>>, <<element-th,`<th>`>>
#### Description

This is an EMPTY element
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  hr           EMPTY                                        >
....
